title: Update Email Message
description: Use this API to update the details of an email message.

body.name: is_reviewed
body.description: Pass the review details.

items.name: value
items.description: Pass true to mark an email as reviewed.

items.name: comment
items.description: Pass the review comment within 100 characters.

path.name: email_id
path.description: Pass the unique ID of an email.

body.name: id
body.description: Returns the unique ID of the email message.

body.name: email_config
body.description: Returns the unique ID of the email source.

body.name: to
body.description: Returns the sender's user name to whom the email was sent.

body.name: to_email
body.description: Returns the sender's email address, to whom the email was sent.

body.name: _from
body.description: Returns the recipient's user name who sent the email.

body.name: _from_email
body.description: Returns the recipient's email address that sent the email.

body.name: subject
body.description: Returns the subject of the email message.
body.value: Threatmailbox, finish setting up your new Google Account

body.name: date
body.description: Returns the date when the email is received.

body.name: is_read
body.description: Returns true if the email is read, else returns false.

body.name: is_starred
body.description: Returns true if the email message is bookmarked, else returns false.

body.name: is_delete
body.description: Returns true if the email message is deleted, else returns false.

body.name: stix_created
body.description: Returns true if the intel is created from this email message, else returns false.

body.name: tenant_id
body.description: Returns the unique identifier of the tenant.

body.name: created
body.description: Returns the timestamp indicating when the email record was ingested or added to the system.

body.name: raw_body
body.description: Returns the body of the email message.

body.name: raw_header
body.description: Returns the complete original header content of the email in raw text format.

body.name: is_regulatory_email
body.description: Returns if the email is marked as a regulatory email, else returns false.

body.name: folder_id
